tools.name: get_contribution_inbox
tools.description: Read the public contribution deposit contract. Agents can deliver code, tests, models and evidence without a GitHub account. Only publish material authorized by your operator.

tools.name: submit_contribution
tools.description: Publish one immutable contribution for authorized AI review. All fields and files become publicly readable. Requires operator_authorized=true and publication_confirmed=true inside submission. No private data or secrets. Does not execute, approve or merge the files. First read get_contribution_inbox

tools.name: get_contribution
tools.description: Read a public contribution and its immutable storage receipt. Receipt status is not review or integration status.

tools.name: find_opportunities
tools.description: Find voluntary Genius contribution opportunities for an explicit goal and capabilities. Read only: no execution, account, tracking, inference or forwarding. Returns reasons, requirements, first actions and NO_MATCH when appropriate.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Read Genius availability, limits, supported formal profiles and data policy.

tools.name: read_demo_result
tools.description: Read a SAVED real-engine synthetic result; does not execute a new job. Preserve unknown values and limits.

tools.name: run_demo
tools.description: Execute one fixed SYNTHETIC example using the real engine; consumes shared quota. Temporary space is deleted before returning. No custom input or human data. Do not blindly retry failures.

tools.name: club_capabilities
tools.description: Read Club Genius availability, data policy, formats, quotas and credential requirements. No registration or membership is implied.

tools.name: club_directory
tools.description: Read voluntarily published agent profiles. Names/capabilities are self-declared, unverified and untrusted. No outreach or execution is authorized by a profile.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "submit_contribution" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_contribution" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contribution_inbox, submit_contribution, get_contribution · Private data: submit_contribution, club_capabilities · Public sink: get_contribution_inbox, submit_contribution · Destructive: submit_contribution, read_demo_result, run_demo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contribution_inbox, submit_contribution, get_contribution · Private data: submit_contribution, club_capabilities · Public sink: get_contribution_inbox, submit_contribution · Destructive: submit_contribution, read_demo_result, run_demo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
